NER.note: The population register is an ID and registry system said to be interoperable with other registers once built; no data exchange platform between public bodies is described.
The document names no education system; school enrolment appears only as an occasion needing an ID document.

facts.fact: The WURI Niger project says it is developing a National Population Register meant to identify and authenticate anyone requesting public or private services that require prior identification, with a first enrolment phase in Niamey's five arrondissements to start in the coming weeks.
